prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a fourth VISUAL DIRECTION BOARD for the family's original co-op game universe "МЕНДЕЛЕЕВЫ · 65382". Title "04 / МАСТЕРСКАЯ БУДУЩЕГО". Landscape 2304x1536.
Image1 is our previous board ONLY for established asset SHAPES and the comparable board content. Images2-5 are art references: 2 modern architecture with vivid lemon and sky-blue fields plus fine drawing; 3 a shared sculptural encounter; 4 tactile assembled material surrounding a luminous amber window; 5 a dense layered collage with fluorescent patches. Translate their general ideas into an entirely ORIGINAL family sci-fi universe, do not reproduce any artwork/composition/figures or put these works on our assets. No artist signatures or external brand text.
Radically different from first board's glossy generic spaceship movie: tactile playful sculptural 3D, chunky irregular pearl-white ceramic panels, carefully joined blue polymer parts, subtle graphite linework from children's drawings printed on selected surfaces, warm amber glass power cores, ultramarine, sky turquoise and bold acid lemon planes. Contemporary optimistic far future, clean and inventive, NOT antique, medieval, distressed junk, sepia, baroque, photoreal movie. Mix simple Roblox-like readable volumetric shapes with lovingly handmade material irregularities. Large quiet areas plus small concentrated clusters of ORIGINAL family pictograms, postage-like exploration stamps, sketch fragments, planetary symbols. Keep collage to collectible cards and ship decals, not busy full backgrounds.
Board: spacious cream-white gallery background, strong graphic editorial layout. Upper hero: Alpha round planet with THREE vast blue waterfall channels and FOURTEEN clearly separated orbital spheres, lemon flat modular towers and delicate hand-drawn maps; smaller misty domed Foggy Albion; smaller Levka circular planet with several pointed-roof geometric towers and oval surface markings. No new canonical lore.
Middle: blue Snowflake aircraft with rounded swept wings/long fuselage and clay-like subtle shape; triangular BMW open-frame ship with oval rear disk and SAFE dark core in amber ring; tall rectangular-frame BMW with wide roof, suspended upside-down cone and ovalcore; rectangular multistory flyinghouse on saucer with mini ship hangar, label "20 мини-кораблей". Preserve recognizable silhouettes from image1.
Lower: ВОРА (exact Cyrillic), 1,10,100 credits as beautiful matte/translucent collectible cards with crescent and star, ancient anonymous figure emblem as small original line drawing, bright original family collage stamps. Family flag: bold simple long-haired bearded Mendeleev silhouette, dots symbolizing125 planets, exact symbols "A1 HO HE RO". Xbox-like tall console with side pullout controller trays and a warmly glowing amber power window; blackhole module safe energy. Bottom right illustrative co-op game scene exactly FOUR simple blocky rounded explorers blue/coral/mint/yellow around one shared circular navigational platform in bright modular landscape, helping align an energy bridge. Do NOT copy the spider sculpture or actual people from image3.
Typography bold contemporary geometric Cyrillic sans, small handwritten marginal doodles only. Sample "АЛЬФА / Летим вместе / 1234". Five color swatches. Footer "КОНЦЕПТ · 04". Labels concise legible Russian. This is an art direction proposal, not production gameplay. Memorable and strange, playful and material, clearly futuristic, no gothic/war/steampunk look.
